visual_review.outcome: All final 53 pages were rendered at 108 dpi and inspected in fourteen contact sheets after the strengthened theorem changed the pagination. Pages 50 and 51 containing the accumulation, multiplicity and uniform-count arguments were additionally inspected individually at full rendering size. No clipping, overlap, missing glyphs or orphaned new heading was observed. The conserved quantity, zero-set proof, finite simple switching, compactness corollary and exact local obstructions are legible.
